tasks.label: Build PyInstaller
tasks.command:
if (Test-Path target\rxgaming) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath target\rxgaming -Recurse -Force }
$env:PYTHONPATH='python'
$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'
conda run -n rxgaming pyinstaller --noconfirm --clean --distpath target --workpath build\pyinstaller rxgaming.spec

tasks.label: Run Python Tests
tasks.command:
$env:PYTHONPATH='python'
$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'
conda run -n rxgaming python -m unittest discover -s python/tests

tasks.label: Update submodules
tasks.command: git submodule update --remote --merge && git add src/lapisgis src/lico src/processedfolder src/rxtools
